# Nutrition Plan for Muscle Gain

## Daily Caloric Target
**~2,800-3,000 calories** (moderate surplus of 300-500 calories above maintenance)

## Macronutrient Breakdown
- **Protein**: 165-190g (2.2-2.5g per kg bodyweight)
- **Carbohydrates**: 350-400g (fuel for training & recovery)
- **Fats**: 75-90g (hormone production & health)

## What to Eat

### **Protein Sources** (every meal)
- Chicken breast, turkey, lean beef
- Salmon, tuna, white fish
- Eggs (whole eggs for nutrients)
- Greek yogurt, cottage cheese
- Protein powder (whey/casein) for convenience

### **Carbohydrate Sources**
- Rice (white or brown), quinoa, oats
- Sweet potatoes, regular potatoes
- Whole grain bread, pasta
- Fruits (bananas, berries, apples)
- Vegetables (broccoli, spinach, mixed veggies)

### **Healthy Fats**
- Avocado, olive oil
- Nuts and nut butters
- Fatty fish (salmon, mackerel)
- Whole eggs

## Sample Daily Meal Plan

**Breakfast**: 4 eggs, 2 slices whole grain toast, avocado, banana

**Snack**: Greek yogurt with granola and berries

**Lunch**: Grilled chicken (200g), rice (1.5 cups), mixed vegetables

**Pre-workout**: Oats with protein powder and peanut butter

**Post-workout**: Protein shake with banana

**Dinner**: Salmon (200g), sweet potato, salad with olive oil

**Evening snack**: Cottage cheese with nuts

## Key Tips
- Eat protein with every meal
- Time carbs around workouts
- Stay hydrated (3-4L water daily)
- Be consistent with meal timing
- Track progress and adjust calories as needed
